description:
After JMAP-06zp.1 through .4 land:

Update each consumer extension-types crate's AGENTS.md / PLAN.md to declare which of its object types are valid relatedType values for Metadata/Annotation:

- jmap-mail-types: Email, Mailbox, Thread, EmailSubmission?, Identity?
- jmap-calendars-types: Calendar, CalendarEvent, CalendarEventNotification?
- jmap-contacts-types: AddressBook, ContactCard
- jmap-tasks-types: TaskList, Task, TaskNotification?
- jmap-filenode-types: FileNode
- jmap-chat-types: Chat, Message, Space?
- jmap-sharing-types: Principal?, ShareNotification?

The relatedType field in MetadataFilterCondition is a string identifying which JMAP object type the metadata is attached to. The mapping table here documents the workspace's policy.

Also update workspace AGENTS.md to add jmap-metadata-* row to the Crate Map table and the Dependency Tree diagram.

Update rustdoc/READMEs from JMAP-9wh7 (filter-algebra exclusion docs) to point at the implemented jmap-metadata-types instead of the draft URL.
title: Consumer-crate integration: declare which data types accept metadata
